name: Amatoya Nari
source:
Likes: Citrus aromatic oils
Dislikes: Reptiles and unreasonable things
Hobbies: Watching plays and collecting postcards

A girl from Class 1-6, and one of [url=/c11268]Nana[/url]'s friends that end up with her in Heavenly Host. She is a side character in Extra Chapter 1 in Corpse Party: Blood Covered. She gets annoyed easily, but cares about her friends. She and Nana are childhood friends. She is also revealed to be a fujoshi in 2U, shown when she requests [url=/c6504]Mayu[/url] to add in boys' love content for the script of the drama in Chapter 2.

[From the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Nari_Amatoya]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
